speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have some skin concerns; can you describe the specific lesions you are worried about, including their size, color, and any changes in shape or texture?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penis and Finger)

I have reviewed your history of smoking and the non-healing, crusty lesions on your penis and finger despite previous treatments. Given the location, appearance, and your significant risk factors, these findings are highly suspicious for malignancy. Have you noticed any bleeding, pain, or ulceration in these areas?
